features.label: Mean weekly units
features.description: Average units per week over the weeks the SKU was on sale.

features.label: Revenue
features.description: Total revenue in the training window (drives the ABC class).

features.label: CV squared
features.description: Squared coefficient of variation of non-zero weekly demand (Syntetos-Boylan).

features.label: ADI
features.description: Average demand interval: weeks on sale per week with any demand.

features.label: Zero-demand weeks
features.description: Share of weeks on sale without a single unit sold.

features.label: Seasonal strength
features.description: Strength of the yearly cycle from an STL decomposition of weekly demand (Hyndman's F_S).

features.label: Trend
features.description: Log-linear growth per year of monthly demand: positive grows, negative declines.

features.label: Recent share
features.description: Share of all units sold in the most recent year: life-cycle position.

features.label: Gross margin
features.description: Gross margin as a share of price.

features.label: Holding vs margin
features.description: Yearly cost of holding one unit relative to the margin it earns.

features.label: Bought alone
features.description: Share of the SKU's order lines that are single-item orders.

features.label: Basket size
features.description: Average number of products in orders containing the SKU.

features.label: Units per line
features.description: Average units per order line: high for bulk buyers.
